text: Developers can use individual Gazebo libraries (gz-math, sdformat, gz-transport) directly in their own C++ applications or write custom simulator plugins
quote: Developers: For those who use individual Gazebo libraries (like gz-math, sdformat, or gz-transport) directly in their own C++ applications, or those who are developing custom plugins for the simulator (gz-sim) itself.

text: Simulation can be run headless (server only) using the -s flag, without launching the GUI
quote: Gazebo Sim can also be run headless, i.e. without the GUI, by using the -s (server only) flag.

text: The GUI can be launched independently with -g and connects to a running server instance
quote: the GUI can be run independently using the -g (gui only) flag. On start, the GUI will attempt to connect to a server instance.

text: A lightweight server-only package (gz-sim-server) can be installed without GUI or Qt dependencies for a smaller footprint
quote: the gz-sim10-server package provides a lightweight alternative. It installs only the Gazebo simulation server (gz-sim-server) without any GUI or Qt dependencies

text: Users can develop custom plugins to control robots, sensors, and environment behavior in simulation
quote: Plugins: Develop custom plugins for robot, sensor, and environment control.

text: Model description pages let you copy an SDF snippet to paste directly into your own SDF file
quote: click on the <> icon in the model description page... to copy an SDF snippet into your clipboard. This snippet can be pasted directly into your custom SDF file.

text: Packages that directly depend on Gazebo libraries can use documented Gazebo vendor packages instead of relying only on ros_gz
quote: If your package directly depends on a Gazebo library, instead of relying only on ros_gz, refer to this documentation to learn how to use the Gazebo vendor packages.

text: Access multiple high-performance physics engines (ODE, Bullet, DART) through a plugin-based Gazebo Physics interface
quote: Dynamics simulation: Access multiple high-performance physics engines through Gazebo Physics.

text: GUI framework built on Qt where each interface component is an independent plugin, allowing creation and interaction with simulations
quote: A framework for graphical user interfaces centered around QT. Each component in Gazebo GUI is an independent plugin

text: Extensive command line tools provide simulation introspection and control
quote: Command line tools: Extensive command line tools for increased simulation introspection and control.

text: Documentation guides using different ROS versions in combination with different Gazebo versions before installing ros_gz
quote: This document provides guidance on using different versions of ROS in combination with different versions of Gazebo.

text: Numerous ready-made robot models (PR2, Pioneer2 DX, iRobot Create, TurtleBot) and environment models are available via Gazebo Fuel
quote: Simulation models: Access numerous robots including PR2, Pioneer2 DX, iRobot Create, and TurtleBot, and construct environments using other physically accurate models available through Gazebo Fuel.

text: Simulation can run on remote servers and be interfaced via socket-based message passing using Gazebo Transport
quote: TCP/IP Transport: Run simulation on remote servers and interface to Gazebo Sim through socket-based message passing using Gazebo Transport.
